title: The Underground Arcade
content: I’m wondering if anyone here has ever visited this location in Mall World? The underground Arcade. The Arcade is in the basement level of the Mall and functions as a midway with games and entertainment but also as a corridor between two upper level sections of the Mall. The Arcade is long and narrow and dark. The carpet is very retro, patterned sort of like a Galaxy swirl. The Arcade is mostly video games, but there are also a few carnival games and food vendors and stuff. For some reason the Arcade is not always open, but when it is - it’s cool AF! Just a trippy and fun place to walk through. It also connects to another area of the Mall with rollercoasters and water slides - but that area is kind of its own thing. Like most of my Mall World experiences, there are other people in the Arcade but they are almost phantom like but not in a scary way.
